findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] app/main.py: setup_static_files_and_docs returns before registering the /, /docs and /redoc handlers when settings.ENVIRONMENT is ENV.PRODUCTION, so the documentation routes do not exist in production rather than being conditionally hidden; the companion app factory constructs FastAPI with docs_url=None, redoc_url=None and openapi_url=None under production, withdrawing the schema alongside the UIs. Environment-driven conditional-OpenAPI is exactly the recommended fix, and StaticFiles is bound to a module-relative public assets directory | verdict=pass confidence=high
